title: Fermionic Character of Low-Lying Excitations
exact_target: Determine whether low-energy excitations of the weakly interacting fermionic system admit a fermionic quasiparticle description.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005746 (OWR-14298014-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Mathematics of Many-body Fermionic Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/49, pp. 2809--2849. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: A mathematical answer must state a spectral or dynamical comparison and its limiting regime; the source does not reduce the question to comparing ground-state energies.
